what: Laptop A integration of the ontology lane wave onto origin/main

What stays on the branches is named there: 190 bulk generated censuses (113 MB), 367 git-ignored paths, 88 root-level scratch files and one 1.16 MB census.

firing_note: script/m14/firing-check-v2.mjs, NFILES=200, production path (getParser->parse->analyze). before = main's pre-integration revisions; after = origin/main 4cf800a17. HASKELL's before was not measured. KOTLIN was re-measured on both lane revisions DERIV_EXPORTS_KOT3 and DERIV_EXPORTS_KOT4 on their own trees and both report 9/10, so ONTOLOGY-PROGRESS.md's 10/10 for Kotlin is not reproducible at NFILES=200 and is sampling-sensitive until re-derived.
lane_claims_caveat: ONTOLOGY-PROGRESS.md's per-lane 10/10 numbers hold on each lane's own branch and its own harness revision; main carries a mix (8 compiler-verified unions, 15 single coherent revisions), so main's own number is the one in firing_before_after, not the lane's claim.

fixture_landing_2026_10_07.what: the lane pin corpus is on main, and the analyzer revision each lane runs was chosen by measuring whole-file alternatives against those pins

corpus.baseline_update: validation/m14/fixture-baseline.json was regenerated by a full run's --update-baseline; it previously gated only javascript/elixir/nim (all 0) and now carries the measured count for every lane, so growth in any lane trips the gate
corpus.claim_effect: the declared failing count rises from 47 to 136 because pins from analyzer generations main does not carry were landed instead of left off main; the contract's rule is that a missing fixture counts as a failed one

fixture_landing_2026_10_07.selection_rule: a whole-file revision was landed only if it satisfied more pins than main's revision and broke none of the pins main satisfies; candidates were the five newest distinct revisions per lane (lanes hold 9-70 distinct revisions each)

src/ast/real-ruby-analyzer.ts.note: the newest revision of the same file, cfc50deca (wip(ruby): preserve uncommitted analyzer), scores identically on the pins

no_dominant_alternative.verdict: for the other 22 lanes with failing pins, every tested alternative revision broke at least one pin main satisfies
no_dominant_alternative.detail: per-lane table with the best alternative and what it would break: archive/docs-pre-consolidation/analyzers-BRANCH-INVENTORY-2026-10-07.md section 2

fold_recheck.method: each of the nine analyzers the 2026-10-07 fold changed was run against its lane's pins, pre-fold blob vs folded blob

lost.groovy/imports-dependency-edge: requires from=package with relationshipType single_type_import; the newer groovy/imports-dependency requires from=the primary type and forbids the older forms
lost.java/module-exports-jpms: expects exports rows over JPMS packages; the newer java/module-info-directives rules them out in writing and forbids the references row it requires
lost.kotlin/exports-visibility: writes the file-level source as the placeholder (file); the newer kotlin/exports-file-identity requires the file's base name and forbids root

coherence_pass.first_result: withholding each pin whose source revision is not on main (169 files)
coherence_pass.rejected_because: the contract counts a missing fixture as a failed one, so withholding documents nothing; the withheld files were restored and the failures declared instead
